description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for the Users module in a CRM system, including functions to check Asterisk server details, retrieve Asterisk extensions, and generate JavaScript for form validation related to user data entry.

methods.name: checkAsteriskDetails
methods.description: Checks if Asterisk server details are set in the database; returns 'true' or 'false' as string.

methods.name: getAsteriskExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves assigned Asterisk extensions for active users from the database.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of user form data, including Asterisk extension checks and email validation.
